_what_these_establish: Per-participant `zone` is carried on BOTH battle_started and battle_update. It is not exclusive to the your_zone field.

`inner` is now WIRE-ATTESTED. Before this capture it appeared only in pkg/spar's zoneIndex ladder (outer:0, mid:1, inner:2, engaged:3) with no server evidence. `outer` and `inner` are now confirmed; `mid` and `engaged` remain repo-internal assumptions.

BOTH participants report the SAME zone value in both frames (outer/outer, then inner/inner). Zone reads as a shared engagement distance between the sides, not an independent per-ship position. If that holds, a fleeing quarry drags the shared zone back outward, which is mechanically why advance has to repeat.
The battle opened at outer and reached inner after the operator issued `battle advance`. Elapsed 17:34:53 -> 17:35:13, with the advance at 17:34:56.
auto_pilot is FALSE in this battle. In the earlier Drift-Ray capture at market_prime it was TRUE. The operator was issuing manual battle commands in this one and not in that one.
